seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Two Democrats. The SoS certified list (search summary), the AP item (dated June 3, 2026), and the LA Almanac agree on Gomez vs Gonzales-Torres. The ABC7 table shows Gomez 46% (54,993) and Gonzales-Torres 31% (36,708). In early counts, Republican Calvin Lee was third. CONFLICT: Ballotpedia's general listing names Arthur Dixon instead; this is likely a pre-primary combined list. A Center Square copy mislabeled this race District 32. BALLOT DESIGNATION LEADS (unverified, from a garbled PDF text extraction in a search summary): Gomez's entry appeared to read U.S. Representative/Parent, and the lines Advocate For Justice and Community Advocate appeared near Gonzales-Torres. Both designations are left null until someone reads the PDF. One article described Gonzales-Torres as an activist; the exact source URL was not pinned down. Offices, education, and birth details were not researched because the web-search budget ran out. Incumbent means the current member for district number 34; Prop 50 redrew the boundaries.
